techniques.name: ANSI and OSC presentation stripping
techniques.transform_oracle: Remove certified SGR controls; preserve visible text and OSC-8 label plus URL; reject unknown or integrity-protected control sequences.
techniques.cache_interaction: Suffix-only deterministic output; frozen after first provider exposure.
techniques.recovery_contract: Original UTF-8 bytes and sha256 retained for the run; decoder/oracle reproduces visible semantic payload, not terminal styling.

techniques.name: Bounded line-ending normalization
techniques.transform_oracle: Normalize only dialect fields declared presentation-only; byte-sensitive code, patches, signatures, and opaque payloads must decline.
techniques.cache_interaction: Deterministic suffix transform; never rewrites a frozen prefix.
techniques.recovery_contract: Original bytes retained in evidence; no exact-view claim is made.

techniques.name: Order-preserving JSON whitespace minification
techniques.transform_oracle: Parse valid JSON, preserve key and array order plus scalar types, remove insignificant whitespace, decode and deep-compare, and decline duplicate-key ambiguity.
techniques.cache_interaction: Applies only to newly appended eligible typed output and is then frozen.
techniques.recovery_contract: Stored original bytes plus ordered parsed representation must round-trip to the same JSON value; original sha256 remains authoritative.

techniques.name: Spinner and carriage-return progress collapse
techniques.transform_oracle: Replay certified progress-control bytes into a deterministic terminal-line state and emit the final visible frame; warnings and diagnostics always decline.
techniques.cache_interaction: Suffix-only; never edits a previously provider-visible progress span.
techniques.recovery_contract: Original byte stream retained for audit; exact byte recovery is not claimed for the model-visible view.

techniques.name: Consecutive repeated-line encoding
techniques.transform_oracle: Encode only consecutive identical complete lines; decode candidate and require byte-for-byte equality and sha256 equality; candidate must count strictly smaller.
techniques.cache_interaction: New typed suffix only; cache-economic veto rejects a smaller candidate that worsens billed prefix economics.
techniques.recovery_contract: Versioned decoder plus retained original artifact reconstruct exact bytes and sha256.

techniques.name: Provider-visible exact duplicate reference
techniques.transform_oracle: Require byte identity, exact source still model-visible in frozen provider ledger, scoped authorization, self-describing reference, and strictly smaller provider count.
techniques.cache_interaction: References never target evicted or rewritten history; cache-economic veto applies.
techniques.recovery_contract: Resolve tenant/session-scoped capability to retained original bytes and verify sha256.

techniques.name: Content-defined sub-result deduplication
techniques.transform_oracle: FastCDC 512B/2KiB/8KiB boundaries, at least 70 percent exact overlap, all references provider-visible and scoped, decoded bytes and hash identical.
techniques.cache_interaction: Anchors only against the frozen provider-view prefix; cache-economic veto required.
techniques.recovery_contract: Ordered chunks resolve to scoped artifacts and concatenate to the original sha256.

techniques.name: Within-turn sibling output overlap deduplication
techniques.transform_oracle: Select one ordered canonical sibling span and self-describing references for byte-identical rows, files, or JSON subtrees; reconstruct each sibling exactly.
techniques.cache_interaction: Operates before the fan-out suffix is first exposed; frozen as one provider suffix.
techniques.recovery_contract: Sibling reference map plus retained originals reconstruct every result and sha256.

techniques.name: Ordered JSON array and table codec
techniques.transform_oracle: Encode homogeneous typed rows with a versioned schema; preserve column order, row order, nulls, and scalar types; decode to deep equality and require a strict count win.
techniques.cache_interaction: Stable schema is placed once in the new suffix and frozen; provider cache economics veto applies.
techniques.recovery_contract: Versioned decoder and retained original JSON/table bytes reproduce ordered typed values and original hash.

techniques.name: Changed-since-turn file reread delta
techniques.transform_oracle: Require earlier exact version provider-visible, trusted unchanged-file identity, text file, unified diff under 60 percent of full count, apply diff to base and match current bytes/hash.
techniques.cache_interaction: Never rewrites the base turn; only the reread suffix becomes a diff and is cache-vetoed.
techniques.recovery_contract: Cloud artifact capability expands the full current file; base plus patch must reconstruct exact bytes.

techniques.name: Unchanged file identity reference
techniques.transform_oracle: Trusted typed reread receipt binds path, repository state, bytes, and sha256; earlier exact bytes remain provider-visible; reference must decode exactly.
techniques.cache_interaction: Reuses frozen provider-visible bytes without rerendering history.
techniques.recovery_contract: Scoped content-addressed artifact returns original bytes only after tenant/session authorization.

techniques.name: Typed command-aware output projection
techniques.transform_oracle: Versioned parser preserves command, exit status, failures, filenames, line numbers, diagnostics, and order; unknown/ambiguous/failed output declines; full artifact expansion matches original hash.
techniques.cache_interaction: Projects a newly appended typed command result once; frozen thereafter.
techniques.recovery_contract: Tenant/session-scoped expand_artifact returns the exact original command output.

techniques.name: Successful check output projection
techniques.transform_oracle: Trusted recognized check, integer exit zero, at least 80 lines, no warnings/errors; preserve declared head, diagnostics, and tail; expand to exact bytes.
techniques.cache_interaction: New successful result only; no failed output may be touched.
techniques.recovery_contract: Cloud artifact capability returns exact output and sha256.

techniques.name: Working-set context paging
techniques.transform_oracle: Residency scorer is observable; enforcement requires projection before first exposure or a certified provider-native context epoch and successful exact expansion.
techniques.cache_interaction: Retroactive eviction is forbidden because it breaks frozen prefix stability.
techniques.recovery_contract: Certified cloud expand_artifact or provider-native compaction seam must be present and tested.
techniques.unsupported_reason: No generally certified cooperative cloud context-epoch seam is frozen for Phase 2 v1.

techniques.name: Prefix stability and cache-economic admission
techniques.transform_oracle: Replay provider-visible prefix byte-for-byte, transform new suffix only, simulate declared provider cache economics, and veto any candidate with higher projected billed cost.
techniques.cache_interaction: This technique owns the cache veto but not provider cache truth; provider usage reconciles estimates.
techniques.recovery_contract: Dual client/provider ledgers and request hashes prove exact replay; no content removal is required.

techniques.name: Lazy tool-schema loading
techniques.transform_oracle: All tasks requiring a deferred tool must discover and invoke it with outcome non-inferiority; unsupported tool-search APIs decline.
techniques.cache_interaction: Can reduce cold prefix but may change cache breakpoints; must be tested as a new context epoch.
techniques.recovery_contract: Deferred schema must be fetchable through a certified cloud tool-search contract.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Generic transparent gateway cannot remove client-supplied schemas without a certified discovery loop.

techniques.name: No-op wait and batched tool turn elimination
techniques.transform_oracle: Avoided model call must correspond to typed no-op polling or a declared batch whose ordered results equal individual calls; task outcome remains non-inferior.
techniques.cache_interaction: Avoids paying the accumulated prefix but changes trajectory and therefore needs a separate cooperative cloud contract.
techniques.recovery_contract: No byte recovery claim; full ordered tool results and event receipts remain available.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Transparent provider gateway cannot decide agent wake policy or compose host tool calls.

techniques.name: Proof-bounded semantic result cache
techniques.transform_oracle: Only provably idempotent side-effect-free lookup classes may be studied; coding inference and near-match code prompts never reuse responses.
techniques.cache_interaction: Separate result-cache semantics from provider prefix cache; do not claim provider token savings without usage truth.
techniques.recovery_contract: Original lookup inputs, proof, source-state identity, and cached result remain auditable.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Similarity reuse has a correctness cliff for coding traffic and lacks a Phase 2 safety contract.

techniques.name: Artifact-backed stale-span summarization
techniques.transform_oracle: Summary is evaluated against exact retained ground truth and task outcomes; code, diffs, diagnostics, and user text are excluded.
techniques.cache_interaction: Requires a new context epoch; never replaces a frozen provider-visible span in place.
techniques.recovery_contract: Exact artifact expansion must be certified wherever a summary replaces source content.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Lossy model-generated summaries need a separate safety and cooperative context contract.

techniques.name: Stable efficiency instruction block
techniques.transform_oracle: Inject only Compand-authored stable text at a dialect-certified location; paired task outcomes and human usability must remain non-inferior.
techniques.cache_interaction: Stable at the start of a context epoch so the provider may cache it.
techniques.recovery_contract: Configuration receipt identifies exact injected bytes; removal restores baseline on a new context epoch.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Changes agent behavior and requires model/dialect-specific safety evidence before enforcement.

techniques.name: Hard compression of Compand-authored injected text
techniques.transform_oracle: Only Compand-authored synopsis/stub text; never user, code, diff, or diagnostic content; paired coding outcome evaluation required.
techniques.cache_interaction: Freeze compressed injected block per context epoch and model snapshot.
techniques.recovery_contract: Exact original Compand text retained, but semantic equivalence—not byte identity—is the claim.
techniques.unsupported_reason: No separate model-specific lossy safety contract is frozen.

techniques.name: Response-token budget and terse output shaping
techniques.transform_oracle: Declared task class receives a versioned output budget; truncation, missing required content, and human usability regressions fail the oracle.
techniques.cache_interaction: Primarily output-side; changes future accumulated context and must remain fixed per paired trajectory.
techniques.recovery_contract: No exact recovery claim; original B0 trajectory and evaluator evidence remain available.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Provider gateway cannot safely set task-class output policy without a certified caller contract.

techniques.name: Executable code-action and tool-call batching
techniques.transform_oracle: A declared batch must preserve tool authorization, call order, typed results, failures, and task outcome relative to the individual-call baseline.
techniques.cache_interaction: Avoids repeated schema and accumulated-prefix payment but changes the tool trajectory.
techniques.recovery_contract: Every composed call and ordered result remains present in the run ledger; no byte-transform recovery claim.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Requires an agent or cloud harness inner loop; a transparent gateway may not originate or compose tools.

techniques.name: Lean system prompt and instruction minimization
techniques.transform_oracle: A versioned minimal prompt retains every required instruction and meets paired task, safety, and tool-use non-inferiority on the exact dialect/model tuple.
techniques.cache_interaction: Reduces the cold prefix but creates a distinct cache and certification tuple.
techniques.recovery_contract: Full baseline and minimal prompt bytes are retained; rollback starts a new context epoch.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Transparent gateway cannot delete caller instructions without an explicit cloud prompt-ownership contract.

techniques.name: Image input budget shaping
techniques.transform_oracle: Certified visual tasks preserve required details and outcome score under dimension/tile/color changes; image and text economics remain separate.
techniques.cache_interaction: Image cache and token behavior is provider/model-specific and must be measured separately.
techniques.recovery_contract: Original image artifact retained and authorized for exact expansion.
techniques.unsupported_reason: No Phase 2 v1 visual corpus or non-inferiority contract is materialized.

techniques.name: Joint model tier and context profile selection
techniques.transform_oracle: Explainable routing receipt and paired cost-per-verified-outcome evaluation under a separately frozen model-routing policy.
techniques.cache_interaction: Model changes invalidate cache and certification tuple; context profile and model decision must be attributed jointly.
techniques.recovery_contract: Decision/config receipt only; no byte transform recovery claim.
techniques.unsupported_reason: MODEL-CATALOG-ROUTING owns tier selection; a technique plugin may not own routing.

techniques.name: Learned soft prompt compression
techniques.transform_oracle: Not executable in a black-box cloud gateway; watch provider-native implementations and recertify the residual opportunity.
techniques.cache_interaction: Provider-owned KV/cache behavior; no gateway claim.
techniques.recovery_contract: None available to the gateway.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Requires model-weight or embedding-path access unavailable to the cloud gateway.

techniques.name: Provider-side KV cache compression and reuse
techniques.transform_oracle: Gateway measures exposed cached usage and preserves prefix stability; it does not claim provider KV implementation effects.
techniques.cache_interaction: Defines why stable provider-visible bytes matter; provider usage remains truth.
techniques.recovery_contract: Not applicable; no gateway-visible reversible transform.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Runs inside provider or self-hosted inference engine, not the black-box cloud gateway.

techniques.name: Provider-side speculative decoding
techniques.transform_oracle: Observe provider latency and usage only; no token-saving or transform claim is attributed to Compand.
techniques.cache_interaction: Provider internal and not inferable from gateway prefix behavior.
techniques.recovery_contract: Not applicable.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Provider/model execution optimization affects latency rather than gateway-visible token content.

techniques.name: Transport wire compression
techniques.transform_oracle: Compressed transport bytes decode exactly to the same model-visible request; model token count and provider charge must remain unchanged.
techniques.cache_interaction: Transport encoding is below the model-visible/cache-key layer and cannot claim context savings.
techniques.recovery_contract: Standard lossless transport decoder reconstructs wire payload.
techniques.unsupported_reason: Saves bandwidth, not model tokens or whole-task provider cost; retained as an explicit negative control.
